customize_intro.text: Hello, little princess! Let's make you look just right.

customize_done.text: Oh, how lovely you look! Let's go to your castle!

castle_intro.text: Welcome to your castle! It is big, and beautiful, and a little bit quiet.
I wish I had some friends to share it with.
Just then, a sparkly butterfly named Flutter came dancing down from the sky!
Flutter had big news. A baby unicorn is lost in the Enchanted Forest!
Oh no! Let's go and help!
Tap the magic map, and off you go!

map_intro.text: Here is the magic map! Tap the glowing forest.

map_locked_bark.text: Shh, that place is still asleep. Maybe one day!

forest_arrive.text: The Enchanted Forest! Giant flowers, glowing mushrooms, and somewhere in here, a little lost unicorn.

found_hoofprints.text: Sparkly hoofprints! Lumi must have come this way.

forest_secret_found.text: A secret glade! Look, a shiny Magic Star!

river_broken_bridge.text: Oh no! The bridge over the river is broken.
How can I get across? I know! Flower Magic!

bridge_grown.text: Vines grew and grew, and flowers bloomed all along the way.

lumi_rescued.text: The thorny vines twirled and twinkled, and turned into flowers.
You found me! You found me!
I am now! Thank you, princess!
And a Magic Star appeared, shining brighter than all the rest.
Come on, Lumi. Let's go home to the castle!

castle_after_rescue.text: Back at the castle, the magical stable opened its doors, just for Lumi.
This is your new home, Lumi!
Lumi looks tired. Let's take good care of her!

care_intro.text: Tap the brush, the apple, and the heart.

care_hint_brush.text: Tap the brush, then tap Lumi.

care_hint_feed.text: Tap the apple, then tap Lumi.

care_hint_hug.text: Tap the heart, and give Lumi a hug.

care_best_friends.text: Lumi and the princess were now the very best of friends.

star_first.text: You got a Magic Star! Look how your crown sparkles!

moonlit_start.text: That night, the moon rose high over the forest, and everything began to glow.
The Moonflower only grows in the moonlight. Follow me!

hollow_lit.text: The stars twinkled, and a glowing path appeared.

moonflower_blooms.text: Moonlight from the horn, and starlight from the wand, and the Moonflower opened its silver petals.
We found it! Mama is going to love it!

mama_arrives.text: When they got back, someone very special was waiting at the castle gate.
Mama! I brought you a Moonflower for your birthday!
What a wonderful gift! And what wonderful friends you have.
Lumi shared her rainbow magic with the princess. Now she could make rainbows, too!

rainbow_ride_unlocked.text: Do you want to go for a rainbow ride? Come and find me at the stable!
